premises.text: Mobile replaces search as the channel for introducing consumers to products
premises.evidence_span: instead of using search, we're using mobile

premises.text: A store-agnostic rewards app lets shoppers earn rewards in over one million U.S. stores on iPhone
premises.evidence_span: consumers can earn rewards in over one million stores throughout the U.S. with just their iPhone

premises.text: Advertisers can message shoppers in the aisle with product in hand as a virtual end cap
premises.evidence_span: So our advertisers are calling it a virtual end cap

premises.text: Product scan earns points and opens a flexible advertiser interaction page
premises.evidence_span: They earn points, and something even more interesting happens. We call it the product interaction page

premises.text: Coin play on scans can yield additional redeemable points
premises.evidence_span: They can play these coins in a variety of gaming ways and see if they're lucky enough to earn additional points

premises.text: Partnerships supply redeemable prizes including gift certificates and airline miles
premises.evidence_span: Amazon gift certificates, CVS, airline miles with a number of airline partners

value.text: Advertisers get in-store discovery while consumers earn extra shopping rewards
value.evidence_span: advertisers to drive discovery and interaction in-store while providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers to get just a little bit of extra value

causal_links.evidence_span: this advertising is reaching the consumer at that most valuable moment where they're in the store with the product in hand
walking into a store and walking out with rewards
drive foot traffic to your product and have consumers pick it up and check it out

notes: Consumer rewards vs advertiser mobile reach treated as separately revisable modules. Bio and exit excluded.
